laws.LAW-066: Training reproducibility requires explicit seed, environment hash, and dataset version
laws.LAW-067: Training does not promote — candidate artifacts have no promotionDecision or deploymentId
laws.LAW-077: Training admission is fail-closed — no run starts without explicit dataset admission
laws.LAW-078: Training is provider-neutral — provider cannot self-authorize or alter hyperparameters
laws.LAW-079: Checkpoint lineage is explicit — every checkpoint references its parent or is the root
laws.LAW-080: Candidate artifact integrity — canonicalHash covers providerOutputHash and runHash
laws.LAW-081: Reproducibility disclosure is required before terminal outcome succeeds
laws.LAW-082: Terminal run states are immutable — SUCCEEDED/FAILED/CANCELLED cannot reopen
